Compare against Webflow reference:
- /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/boldteq-v1-0.webflow/blog.html
- /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/CMS Data/Boldteq - Blog Posts - 695f68a83604d0d15b8c9ad8.csv (read first 30 lines + check structure)
- /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/CMS Data/Boldteq - Blog Categories - 696b41e46555c3b7b4a07841.csv

Cross-check the Webflow CSS for blog-related classes by grepping `boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css` for: `blog-card`, `blog-hero`, `blog-grid`, `category-tag`, `blog-categories`, `blog-image`, `blog-title`, `blog-description`, `blog-pagination`, `featured-blog`. Note exact padding/margin/font/color/radius values for each.

Check sample blog detail HTML if any exists in the Webflow export under `boldteq-v1-0.webflow/blog/` or similar — find any blog-detail page to verify the [slug] template.

Report:
1. **CRITICAL bugs** (broken rendering, missing data, runtime errors, wrong CSS values vs Webflow source)
2. **DATA bugs** (wrong content, mismatched categories, missing posts, broken slug→post mapping, image src issues)
3. **UI/CSS deviations** vs Webflow reference (padding/margin/font/color/grid/responsive)
4. **Interactivity bugs** (filter, search, pagination, category click handling)
5. **TypeScript/lint issues** (any `any`, missing types, unused imports)
6. **SEO/meta bugs** (missing metadata, broken structured data, alt text)
7. **Detail page bugs** ([slug] route, content rendering, missing fields)

Be exhaustive but concise — bullet list with `file:line — bug → fix-direction`. Under 500 words.
